name: Video Wallpaper
author: p3lusa
description: Desktop wallpaper renderer. Plays the active theme's looping video when that theme ships a videos/ directory, and otherwise behaves exactly like the stock image background (current/background symlink, transitions). Videos pause while the session is locked or idle, and the active clip survives shell restarts. Pairs with the companion video-wallpaper theme (p3lusa/video-wallpaper), which ships the clip library, sample wallpapers, and the neon skin — the theme alone only shows static images without this renderer.
